date_evidence.description: Monograph intention first mentioned December18,1847 and later Quekett contact do not strictly prove January–August1848 endpoints; Fridays December24/31 and September1 satisfy that loose before/after reasoning. Preserve original range and uncertainty, not an automatic new interval.
Date chain conditional on probable recipient; your Society could mean Ray Society rather than Palaeontographical Society. Membership history does not independently prove assigned Thursday.
March8 is conjectural; March15 ruled unlikely, not impossible, by inferred postal turnaround. Yesterday arrival is relative, not safely exact March7.

receipt_events.description: Note yesterday and Geological Society box this morning are separate receipts with unresolved calendar date.

evidence.quote: I received your note yesterday & the Box from the Geological this morning

receipt_events.description: Farnham misdirection delayed letter until yesterday; composition date itself conjectural.

evidence.quote: Your letter having been directed Farnham made an astonishing tour & arrived here only yesterday

receipt_events.date_policy: Same morning under assigned meeting-based April24date; invitation, not grant.

evidence.quote: By the circular received this morning, I see there is a Council of Pal. Soc. on Friday

reference_observations.description: Earlier cleaning permission already used; new drawing permission requested; Copenhagen lot still awaited.

whether you will permit me to have some of your specimens drawn

reference_observations.description: Thursday deposit intended, not verified dispatch or London presence. Returning Plumularia relates to1229 earlier promise but is same-author continuity.

evidence.quote: I will leave them directed to you at Geolog. Soc. on Thursday next
